title: FedSumUp: User-Auditable Privacy-Aware Representation Sharing for Resource-Constrained Federated Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2610.21194v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing federated data condensation methods face privacy risks, as uploaded synthetic data may preserve sensitive information and remain vulnerable to reconstruction attacks. Moreover, their generation often incurs considerable client-side computational overhead, limiting deployment on resource-constrained devices. To address these issues, we propose FedSumUp, which employs a learnable lossy compressor on clients to generate compact and visually interpretable representations. By controlling information capacity, FedSumUp reduces privacy leakage while allowing users to directly assess the privacy-utility tradeoff. We further introduce a dual-objective optimization mechanism to preserve task-relevant semantics while suppressing reconstruction risks. The compressor is trained on the server and only performs lightweight inference on clients. Since the server cannot access raw data, we develop a data-free closed-loop optimization strategy

translated_title: FedSumUp：面向资源受限联邦智能的用户可审计隐私感知表示共享
translated_abstract: 现有的联邦数据蒸馏方法面临隐私风险，因为上传的合成数据可能保留敏感信息，且容易受到重建攻击。此外，其生成过程通常会带来相当大的客户端计算开销，限制了在资源受限设备上的部署。为解决这些问题，我们提出了FedSumUp，它在客户端采用可学习的有损压缩器来生成紧凑且视觉上可解释的表示。通过控制信息容量，FedSumUp在减少隐私泄露的同时，允许用户直接评估隐私与效用之间的权衡。我们进一步引入了一种双目标优化机制，在抑制重建风险的同时保留与任务相关的语义信息。压缩器在服务器端训练，客户端仅需执行轻量级推理。由于服务器无法访问原始数据，我们开发了一种无数据的闭环优化策略
tldr: 提出FedSumUp框架，通过在客户端部署可学习的有损压缩器生成紧凑且可解释的表示，既降低了隐私泄露风险和客户端计算开销，又使用户能够直接审计隐私与效用的权衡。
en_tdlr: FedSumUp employs a learnable lossy compressor on clients to generate compact, interpretable representations, reducing privacy leakage and client-side computational overhead while enabling user-auditable privacy-utility tradeoffs in federated learning.
